description: Find local businesses and places on Google Maps when the user asks where something is, wants nearby options, or needs a list of businesses with contact details. Returns one page of up to 20 places, each with its name and Google Maps link plus address, phone, website, category, rating, review count, coordinates, and opening hours when available. Costs 3 credits per page, however many places it holds; use search for webpages and crawl to read a business website.

country.description: Two-letter country code for local results

language.description: Result language, such as en, de, or zh-CN

location.description: Search around this point instead of letting the query decide the area; required for page 2 and later

zoom.description: Map zoom; higher is a smaller area

max_results.description: How many places the answer needs from the page; fewer places do not lower the price

page.description: Google Maps page to fetch; each page is a separate 3-credit call and pages after the first need location

query.description: What to look for on the map, such as "coffee shops" or "dentists in Austin"; a place name in the query sets the area when no location is given

name: maps

results.description: Places in Google Maps order; url is the public Google Maps link and metadata holds the place details that were available

id.description: Stable identifier for this result; for web results this is the canonical URL

text.description: Result snippet or extracted page text when available

url.description: Canonical URL that clients can cite and users can open

title: Find places on Google Maps
